sections.title: Advncd Mthds Of Inq II
sections.description: This course develops student's capacity to articulate and investigate an inquiry question about their own practice. The course builds the capacity of the teacher to use qualitative research strategies to systematically investigate and improve elements of their practice that are important to student learning. The course focuses on qualitative modes of inquiry, building researchable questions, and collecting data. Prerequisite: Enrollment in Independent School Teaching Residency Program.
